bio: RedGlove is another being much like X- possibly also made of VOID matter- that just so happened to follow in X's footsteps into his world. This lead it to stumble upon and subsequently possess an old, discarded vessel X had constructed. By its tie to him, possibly being or having ever been part of him, it ended up binding itself to Lord X and vice versa.
